definitions.explanation: describes doing something in a way that is not direct or obvious, often to avoid being noticed or to be tactful

examples.japanese: それとなく⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みた。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧それとなく⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I subtly conveyed it to him.

examples.japanese: それとなく⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}って→探る：03923_saguru⟧みた。
examples.english: I tried to discreetly find out what was going on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧それとなく⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}した→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧。
examples.english: My mother casually brought up the topic of marriage.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when doing something indirectly or subtly to avoid being too obvious or direct. Common in situations requiring tact or discretion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- それとなく⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ - to ask casually
- それとなく⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ - to convey indirectly
- それとなく⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧ - to probe subtly
- それとなく⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ - to hint at

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{遠回|とおまわ}し→遠回し：08054_toomawashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - in a roundabout way
- ⟦{暗|あん}に→暗に：12974_anni⟧ - implicitly
- ⟦さりげなく→さりげない：07575_sarigenai⟧ - nonchalantly
